theoretical_architecture.objective: Align linguistic failure tokens with physical hardware resource stress

stats.description: Correlates endpoint URI character path length with recorded thread execution duration (duration_ms) across 544 telemetry requests. Tests whether deeper sub-resource endpoints incur higher processing latency.
stats.causation_note: URI length reflects routing hierarchy depth; correlation does not imply string length itself causes execution latency, which is driven by endpoint computational workload and downstream database queries.
